subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): split PortForwardRuleParser parse/apply + unit tests
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): split PortForwardRuleParser parse/apply + unit tests

Extract a pure ParseRules(string) -> IReadOnlyList<PortForwardRule> from ApplyRules
(introducing the PortForwardRule/PortForwardKind value types). ApplyRules now just
parses then dispatches to the tunnel manager. The parsing logic is now fully
unit-testable with no SSH server or test doubles.

Add 15 unit tests covering local/remote/dynamic forwards, case-insensitivity,
multi-rule + trim/empty handling, and skipping of every invalid-rule form.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Refactors fork-specific SshDotNet PortForwardRuleParser; our fork has no SSH.NET protocol (SSH via PuTTY). Nothing to apply.
